name: A card in a graveyard or exile has its characteristic-defining abilities, counted for its owner and not counting itself — Regal Bunnicorn, Tarmogoyf, Mistform Ultimus, Transguild Courier
notes: Memory: project_emblems_not_counted_as_permanents_2026-11-11 (zone cards section). computeZoneCardState (the inspector's Details pop-up for a graveyard / exile / command-zone card) injected only the card's own effects flagged appliesToNonBattlefieldZones, so a characteristic-defining ability never applied there: Regal Bunnicorn in a graveyard was 0/0 and Tarmogoyf in exile 0/0. A CDA functions in every zone (CR 604.3). Its CDAs are now injected too, with 'you' the card's owner (CR 108.4a: a card outside the battlefield has no controller; before, it was the active player), and the zone card is no permanent (6880a15), so it does not count itself. Here the first player controls Regal Bunnicorn, an Ornithopter and a Forest, the opponent an Ornithopter. The first player's graveyard Bunnicorn counts Bunnicorn and Ornithopter (2/2; not itself, not the Forest), the opponent's counts the opponent's Ornithopter (1/1), and the battlefield Bunnicorn is still 2/2. Tarmogoyf in exile counts one card type (creature) among the two graveyard Bunnicorns: 1/2 (fixed along the way: 'card types among cards in all graveyards' counted cards, 2/3 here, on the battlefield too; _computeForEachCount now counts distinct types, a split card with both halves'). Mistform Ultimus in exile is every creature type and Transguild Courier all colors.

cdaAbilities: This card's power and toughness are each equal to the number of nonland permanents you control.
